Middle East.headline: Yemen / Red Sea — Fatal Houthi missile attack on cargo ship in Bab al-Mandeb Strait
Middle East.body: Yemeni officials reported that Iran-backed Houthi rebels launched a double-tap ballistic missile attack on the Tihamah, a commercial cargo ship carrying food through the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. The initial strike ignited a fire that killed four crew members—three Pakistani nationals and one Indonesian—and injured four others. A secondary strike hit the vessel during search and rescue operations, killing two Yemeni rescue workers, bringing the total death toll to six. The Houthis claimed the attack targeted a military vessel enforcing a siege. Separately, the United States military disabled a vessel near the Gulf of Oman using helicopter-fired Hellfire missiles.

Middle East.headline: Iraq — Unclaimed airstrikes kill security personnel in Kirkuk and Mosul
Middle East.body: Airstrikes near Kirkuk killed three members of Iraq's Popular Mobilisation Forces (PMF) and two Iraqi police officers. In a separate strike targeting PMF positions near Mosul, approximately 105 miles northwest of Kirkuk, two additional Iraqi police officers were killed. The PMF attributed the strikes to the United States and Israel, though neither country has confirmed involvement. The attacks occur alongside heightened regional tensions linked to confrontation involving Iran, prompting the United States Embassy in Baghdad to issue security warnings.

Middle East.headline: Gaza / OPT — Israeli drone strike hits vehicle near Al Bureij shelter camp
Middle East.body: An Israeli drone strike targeted and destroyed a vehicle just after it departed a shelter at the Abu Asi Orphan Camp in Al Bureij, central Gaza. The vehicle belonged to a worker involved in supporting displaced children and families at the facility. Local humanitarian workers continued providing assistance to displaced populations despite the attack. Israel has not provided immediate details regarding the operational justification for the strike.

Middle East.headline: Syria — Armed attack on military position near Qamishli kills two soldiers
Middle East.body: An attack by an unidentified group on a Syrian army position in Tawil Harb village, located in the Qamishli countryside of northeast Syria, killed two soldiers and wounded two others. The targeted unit belonged to the Qamishli Brigade, which comprises integrated members of the Syrian Democratic Forces. Military officials reported that local forces repelled the assault and launched security operations to locate and apprehend those responsible.

Africa.headline: DR Congo: 2,011 killed as Ebola outbreak cases hit 4,381
Africa.body: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has resulted in the deaths of 2,011 people out of 4,381 confirmed cases, according to Congolese officials on Tuesday. This toll brings it close to the DRC’s deadliest Ebola outbreak, which occurred between 2018 and 2020, resulting in nearly 2,300 deaths out of 3,500 recorded cases. The current outbreak, which has primarily affected the DRC’s conflict-ridden eastern and northeastern regions, was declared on May 15 but is believed to have been spreading for several weeks prior. Asia-Pacific.headline: Assam: How a 97-year-old escaped deadly Indian floods on a banana log raft
Asia-Pacific.body: - Published Well past midnight on 19 July, as floodwaters surged through a village in India's northeastern state of Assam, Bornali Baruah and her husband were trying to save his 97-year-old mother. Almost bedridden, Lokada Duarah could not walk. There was no boat, no rescue team and no neighbour available to help. So they lifted her onto a makeshift raft made of banana trunks, and carried her through the rushing water towards safety. "Everyone was trying to save themselves," Baruah says.
